propositions: Close transition must require a separately attested current plan review before allowing ticket closure when enforcement is enabled, without invalidating implementation due to code file changes during execution.
Implementation depends on predecessor stories 75de and 5967 to deliver PlanValidityProfile.CLOSE, compute_validity() with profile parameter, phase compatibility checking, and signed review contracts.

close_plan_review_gate_check() runs as a pure local gate inside a critical write lock, verifying plan/signature/phase/material/pin validity while explicitly excluding code freshness checks, and fails closed with structured verdict and remediation on any unexpected exception.

The CLOSE validity profile accepts certified, registry-current, material-current, phase-compatible reviews despite HEAD or per-file dependency hash drift; unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, phase incompatibility, and malformed metadata always block.

Pre-status-check callback (`pre_status_check` parameter to `txn.transition_core()`) executes inside the existing single write lock after structural/status checks but immediately before STATUS append, enabling race rejection between precheck and lock without separate critical sections.

Enforcement is default-off via `require_plan_review_for_close=false`; bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, and idea→closed remain exempt; non-empty force-close reason bypasses both plan-review and completion gates.
